description: Defines classes and functions for managing downlink HARQ buffers in a cellular network, including buffer handles, buffer pools, and related operations.

classes.name: dl_harq_buffer_handle
classes.description: Manages ownership and transfer of a DL HARQ buffer, allowing transfer to shared transport blocks.

classes.name: cell_dl_harq_buffer_pool
classes.description: Manages allocation, deallocation, and fetching of DL HARQ buffers for a specific cell.

methods.name: transfer_to_buffer_view
methods.description: Transfers ownership of the buffer to a shared transport block, only callable once.

methods.name: allocate_dl_harq_buffer
methods.description: Allocates a DL HARQ buffer for a specific UE and HARQ ID, returns a handle.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all buffers in the pool, typically on cell deactivation.

methods.name: allocate_ue_buffers
methods.description: Allocates buffers for a new UE.

methods.name: deallocate_ue_buffers
methods.description: Deallocates buffers for a removed UE.
